metadata.topic: Buying from a vendor; PC mouse and keyboard; 60 fps at full speed
metadata.description: An emblem is bought from Eva Levante with Glimmer: the Glimmer is spent and the emblem arrives as owned.
metadata.previous_state: Vendor screens opened with their stock, but every price read 0 Glimmer and nothing could be bought.
metadata.current_state: Glimmer reaches the game, the purchase is sent, and the server's answer spends the Glimmer and delivers the item.
metadata.remaining_issue: Purchases priced in character-held currencies, selling, and the other vendors are untested; the Guardian still renders without a head in third person.
metadata.next_task: Selling, other vendors and reputation; the game's own PC key bindings; the Guardian's missing head.
metadata.audio: game audio only, one emulator port; music may be present
